title: Figure 9: An Optical Material Deforms the Coordinates of Space – virtual vs. real space
description: Two side-by-side grid diagrams. Panel A (virtual space) shows a square grid with a blue circle, a red center dot and a straight yellow line; panel B (real space) shows the grid lines warped around a red inner circle, with the yellow line curving over it. The caption reads "Figure 9. An Optical Material Deforms the Coordinates of Space. A: virtual space, B: real space."
